model_scope: Same CVC-U1 structured sort-definition meaning, owned parameters, exact byte/AST bindings, S1 comparator and four target obligations; separately named host-assumption envelope A7. Reuse the exact CVC2 signature bytes in a new protocol, preserving the original specification as historical. Host assumptions are not object-language axioms admitted in the submitted artifact.
trust_interpretation: Explicit conditional assumptions, not source approvals or proven helper facts. Exact imported source statements and compiled declarations must be compared in the counted baseline. Runtime binary/import identities are rebound to the existing prepared payloads; source-to-binary provenance remains unproved unless separate evidence establishes it.

preparation.target: An executable, committed protocol and runner for CVC-U1-A7, with exact seven-axiom baseline auditing and inherited process controls.
scope: Create new assumption/protocol/config/runner paths and a new immutable manifest. Preserve the original runner, source, allowlist and terminal run evidence.

Reuse existing process supervision and exact dependency bundle through stable interfaces. Fix a new named baseline stage that is counted like every other Lean build and cannot run until the later proof item is promoted.

Use inert supervised fixtures only, reserving exact source/test identities before a batch. The 64-launch and 320-second ceilings include focused and required regression fixture launches; launch-free structural mocks may be used for pure tests.
Record UTC/monotonic sessions, failed reservations and process cleanup; no fixture or proof environment override can enter production commands.
Prepare complete entry review and required evidence validators, then commit/push and select the proof item without launching it.
preparation.completion: New exact manifest/protocol/runner plus regression evidence, declaration/type and exact-seven baseline audit, immutable old-run refusal, closure and a separate committed proof entry decision. Ordinary repair remains inside this item while authorized budgets permit; immutable model changes require an explicit successor.

proof.budget_relationship: Six newly authorized reservations in an explicit successor, not reuse of the predecessor ten unspent slots. Preserve original two attempts and 199.947382292 active seconds/2.357550584 compilation seconds; original-plus-proposed proof launches are at most eight. Preparation and required closure validation costs remain separately visible; prior unknown fixture duration remains unknown.
entry_gates: CVC-CONDITIONAL-1 SUCCESS, committed/pushed exact runner and new manifest, preserved source/dependency products, explicit stopping-point PROMOTE decision.
Fixed A7 assumptions, original signature/examples/targets and read-only dependency/runtime preflight. No automatic materialization, download or compilation.

stages.attempt_rule: Next reservation after signature success; failures/retries count within six
stages.input: Fixed Baseline.lean prints imported comparator axioms and fully elaborated types of both comparators and all seven assumptions; no Lab proof source.
stages.pass_rule: Both comparator reports must exactly equal A7, with no missing/extra/duplicate report. Compare printed assumption and comparator types to the fixed reviewed expectations before accepting new Lab proof feedback.

stages.attempt_rule: Remaining reservations after the baseline, normally at most four
stages.input: Reviewed proof implementation; only implementation edits between attempts
stages.pass_rule: All original required result declarations/types and exact acceptance/boundary obligations; print per-result transitive sets plus both comparator reports. Lab sets may be exact reported subsets of A7. Reject sorryAx, new Lab axioms, native evaluation trust, missing printouts or unlisted axioms.

proof.stop: SUCCESS for the exact checked conditional theorem and all obligations, NEGATIVE for a checked counterexample, or BOUNDED_UNRESOLVED at a true cap/immutable-input/authority boundary or documented unrepairable implementation gap. Repair ordinary proof errors inside the same active item. A baseline assumption mismatch never expands the list after feedback.
proof.nonclaims: No axiom discharge or consistency, no arbitrary-byte parser proof, no executable whole-validator refinement, no automatic CVC-4 activation.

downstream.cvc4: Keep the original CVC-4 proposal PLANNED with its unmet CVC-3 SUCCESS dependency. If the new proof succeeds, create an explicit CVC-4 successor scoped to CVC-U1-A7; never reinterpret the old dependency as satisfied.
downstream.cvc5: Retain PLANNED; every intermediate stop records its own contribution/no-action recommendation.

alternative_trigger: If the fixed baseline cannot be reconciled or the conditional result loses utility, rank the pure normal-form comparator alternative against stopping and existing deferred work. It requires its own acceptance definition, assumption audit and source scope; do not switch mid-run.
external_action: No publication or source approval. Any future upstream message still needs exact target-specific human authorization.
